title: Punctured Hamming ports for conditional κ = 0.001457945761723368
body:
This removes eight isolated coordinate ports from the pinned #514 complex construction and supplies a new complete physical owner allocation, in one commit based on main at `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`.

Under the retained all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized Lemma A, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{182243220215421}{125000000000000000}
=0.001457945761723368.
$$

The saving is **4.77335% above [#514](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/514)** and **4.61251% above [#518](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/518)**. The complex supplier binds the assembly. These percentages compare exponent savings, not practical runtime.

## Construction

The eight coordinate source/target pairs occur only as eight independent unit shears in the complete scalar word. Removing these direct summands leaves 112 code ports and all 560 helpers, with the same frames, gauges, kernel relations and arbitrary-dirt restoration. Each removed pair saves two rank-eight children and one rank-one center descent.

The global controller restricts at complete invocation boundaries. A new literal assignment hosts all 40,320 helper uses on whole idle data families, with 784 distinct active owners per invocation. Actual charts, idle windows, spectator restoration and every remaining child are checked against the emitted program.

| Quantity | Pinned #514 | This construction |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Local data ports | 120 | 112 |
| Helpers | 560 | 560 |
| Sum of center ranks | 72 | 64 |
| Live families | 7,680 | 7,168 |
| Physical families | 8,258 | 7,738 |
| Global rank deficit | 2,496 | 2,560 |
| Certified complex saving | 0.001393462495344162153490 | 0.001460074471110324279467 |

Two rational moment engines, six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities give the displayed κ. The unchanged #493 bit supplier is repriced at `0.001565442026981656908596`; its operator remains a cited dependency.

## Proof and validation

The selected package is `research/punctured112-global/`:

- `PROOF.md` and `proof/`: direct-sum restriction, global controller and physical-owner argument.
- `evidence/EXACT-ASSEMBLY.json`: both moments, finite invoice, bootstrap and all 47 strict margins.
- `EXPECTED.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `MANIFEST.json`: exact result, immutable source pins and file bindings.
- `verify.py`: offline standard-library reconstruction, with dedicated Python 3.11/3.14 CI.

```sh
python -B research/punctured112-global/verify.py --work /tmp/punctured112-check
```

Local clean reconstruction passed on Python 3.14.8 in 487.47 seconds: all 14 top-level stages and 13 nested predecessor stages passed. Packaged executable Python ASTs and mathematical inputs match that validated source; only documentation, attribution and manifests were adjusted. The final package manifest SHA256 is `e353b0e9d76cf6253d502f7410d17c228180e98bb6e56072eb869a1d923c3c17`. See `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json`. Remote CI is pending. The package checks both orientations on all 784 arbitrary scalar columns, exact local phases and wrappers, the 112-port global restriction, all 40,320 whole-owner roles, complete paid histograms, coefficient/routing allowances, rational moments and strict assembly. The selected template content SHA256 is `2ae6ac3aff97a861d037ee51d6dcdd7bfe79ecbb0d8f1e186754428abc997a99`.

This also repairs the previously identified historical joint-dual CI source freeze: only the stale top-level `Makefile` and `README.md` pins and their two derived hash bindings change. The historical mathematical certificate is unchanged. Optional search files remain outside the submission; no PDF is generated.

This is a finite conditional witness. The inherited all-size and analytic interfaces remain assumptions; no new Lean proof, global optimality or unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.
